newsitem.title: USA: Billy Bob Thornton, wife, get restraining orders.
newsitem.headline: Billy Bob Thornton, wife, get restraining orders.

text.p: A judge on Wednesday ordered Oscar-winning writer-actor Billy Bob Thornton and his estranged wife, Pietra, to stay away from each other.

Judge Stephen Lachs had previously issued a temporary restraining order against the "Sling Blade" star but broadened it to both parties on Wednesday, saying there was sufficient cause "for restraining orders to be mutual."
Pietra Thornton, who is suing for divorce, has claimed her husband brutalized her since 1992 -- a year before their marriage -- and had threatened to kill her.

But Thornton, who won a best adapted screenplay Oscar this year for "Sling Blade," in which he also starred, said in court papers that it was his wife who had made the death threats and he asked for a restraining ordered against her.
He is also seeking greater access to his two children from the marriage, William, 3, and Harry, 2.

Thornton, 41, and his wife, 27, were both in court for Wednesday's hearing. Married in February 1993, they separated shortly after they appeared arm-in-arm at this year's Academy Awards ceremony, where Thornton won his Oscar.
In her divorce petition, Pietra Thornton asked for sole custody of the children and spousal support.
Thornton was a virtual unknown until "Sling Blade," in which he played a mentally retarded man released from an institution 25 years after killing his mother and her lover.
Born in Malvern, Arkansas, he had small parts in a number of films and television shows and played drums in a rock band.
